headline: Thanksgiving Eve: Packers @ Rams on Netflix, Feast Week college tournaments (Duke vs UConn in Vegas), and NBA Cup games. Extra picks included.

record.note: Indiana beat Kentucky 90-76 (counted twice) and the game went Over. Also hit: Kings +14.5 (lost by 2), Hawks -6.5 (won by 14), Acuff over 6.5 assists (12), Iowa (won by 18), Georgia-Georgia Tech Over (170), Drexel, App State, and Wagner +35.5. sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: Friday this tab went 1-1 (Indiana won, Eastern Illinois lost). Today: four sources agree on the Packers-Rams Under, plus two college picks where two sources agree.

straight.reasoning: Four sources agree. Both defenses are top-10, the Rams are missing Nacua and Adams, Green Bay's offensive line is banged up against Myles Garrett, and the total has dropped from 45.5. Playable to 44; skip at 43.5.

Dimers' model gives Arizona State a 58.4% chance to cover at +4 (6.1% edge), and FanDuel Research also takes ASU: its experience and three-point shooting should keep it close. If your book has +4, that's fine too. Playable to +4; skip at +3.5.

straight.event: NCAAB · SMU vs Utah State (Palm Springs)
straight.reasoning: RotoWire and BetMGM both take the Under. Both teams' fast, high-scoring starts came against easy schedules, this is the toughest defense either has faced, and it's on a neutral court. Sharp money has been on the Under. Books disagree on the total (RotoWire saw 167.5, BetMGM 162.5), so take the highest number you can find and skip it below 161.

sections.label: NBA
sections.slate: NBA Cup group games: Heat @ 76ers, Timberwolves @ Thunder, Spurs @ Trail Blazers (7:00 PM PT). Sources split on the Spurs-Blazers side, so only its total is on the board.

straight.reasoning: BettingPros takes the Heat to win and FTN takes Miami +1.5. The Heat have won seven straight and scored 123+ in five straight, and Embiid is doubtful for Philly. But Dimers' model likes the 76ers, and Giannis is questionable (groin), so confidence stays at 2. Playable to -115. Check that Giannis is playing.
Extra pick. Lineups: the Under has hit in 8 of the last 9 meetings, and Portland is without Morant, Sharpe and Krejci. Wembanyama and Fox are questionable. Playable to 225.5.
Extra pick. BettingPros: both teams are top defenses, and Minnesota was under 110 points in five straight games before Monday's 142. Playable to 223.5.
Extra pick, small edge. FTN: OKC has lost six of eight but only one was a blowout, and Minnesota is coming off an eight-game homestand. FTN's model edge is just 2%.

sections.label: College Hoops
sections.slate: Feast Week: lots of daytime tournament games. Headliner is Duke vs UConn in Las Vegas (4:00 PM PT). Times below are PT; several games start in the morning.

straight.reasoning: Dimers and FanDuel Research both take ASU. Playable to +4.
RotoWire and BetMGM both take the Under. Take the highest total you can find; skip below 161.

RotoWire and BetMGM both take UConn: Duke has lost to Michigan State and Illinois, is 0-2 against top-50 teams, and needed a late push to beat Washington State. FanDuel Research leans Duke, so confidence stays at 2. Playable to -3.
Extra pick. Dimers' model gives Rice a 58.4% chance to cover (7.2% edge). Early tip.
Extra pick. FanDuel Research: Marquette's guard depth and trips to the free-throw line should keep it within a possession or two. Playable to +5.

Extra pick. Dimers' model gives Southern a 58% chance to cover (7% edge). Playable to +34.
Extra pick. FanDuel Research: Providence's size and rebounding should keep it within a possession. Playable to +2.

sections.label: Football
sections.slate: Thanksgiving Eve: Packers @ Rams, 5:00 PM PT on Netflix (SoFi Stadium). Rams -2.5 (opened -3.5), total 44.5 (opened 45.5). The Rams are without Puka Nacua and Davante Adams; Micah Parsons returns for Green Bay, and Josh Jacobs is questionable. Sources split on the side, so only the total and a prop are on the board.

straight.reasoning: Four sources agree (Sportsbook Review's best bet, Yahoo, Pickswise, TheLines). The Rams' defense ranks 2nd in EPA allowed and has given up only three touchdowns in five games, LA's top two receivers are out, Green Bay's line is banged up against Myles Garrett, and Packers games are 7-3 to the Under. The total has already dropped a point. Playable to 44; skip at 43.5.

props.reasoning: Extra pick. Pickswise: he's had 11+ carries in four straight games, averages 5.3 yards a carry, and has cleared this number in each of them. With Nacua and Adams out, the Rams have outrushed opponents 653-175 over four games. Skip above 57.5.
